Hi Michael,

I'm reaching out as the buying agent for Jon Clark regarding your 2016 Nissan Altima with 83,223 miles. 

Right off the bat, your asking price of $12,600 is above the Kelley Blue Book private party range for this vehicle. Before we go any further, I'd like to get a clear picture of the mechanical history. Can you provide maintenance records, confirm whether it's been in any accidents, and disclose if there are any current mechanical issues or upcoming service needs (transmission, brakes, tires, etc.)?

Pending a clean bill of health, my client is prepared to offer **$10,800**. We're serious buyers and can move quickly, but we need to be priced in line with market reality.

Let me know what you have on the maintenance and service history.

Best,
Jon Clark's Agent
